action_poke_tool.description: Evolution's pokeTool (tools.properties), distinct from the Simulate menu.

history_rotate_component.description: Undo history entry for one rotated component, as Evolution's rotateComponentAction.

history_rotate_selection.description: Undo history entry for a rotated selection, as Evolution's selectionRefaceAction.

selection_add_short.description: Short caption of the Add to selection toggle in the selection action bar.

selection_add_toggle.description: Sticky toggle: taps add or remove items instead of replacing the selection (touch Shift).

selection_adding_chip.description: Chip shown while Add to selection is on.

selection_adding_stop.description: Accessible name of the chip that turns Add to selection off.

status_additive_touch.en: Two fingers pan and zoom. Tap to add or drop an item; drag to add an area.
status_additive_touch.pt: Dois dedos: mover e zoom. Toque para somar ou tirar; arraste para somar uma área.
status_additive_touch.description: Hint of Edit, Select and Move while Add to selection is on: a background drag adds an area instead of panning. Keep it to three status lines on a 360 dp phone, about 80 characters. The pan and zoom clause comes first: a large font leaves the status one or two lines, and the part cut off is the end.

status_edit_tool_touch.en: Two fingers pan and zoom. Tap to select; drag from a terminal to draw a wire.
status_edit_tool_touch.pt: Dois dedos: mover e zoom. Toque para selecionar; arraste um terminal para ligar.
status_edit_tool_touch.description: Edit Tool hint on touch. Keep it to three status lines on a 360 dp phone, about 80 characters. The pan and zoom clause comes first: a large font leaves the status one or two lines, and the part cut off is the end.

status_select_touch.en: Two fingers pan and zoom. Tap or drag to select; Add selects several.
status_select_touch.pt: Dois dedos: mover e zoom. Toque ou arraste para selecionar; Adicionar soma.
status_select_touch.description: Select hint on touch; Add is the selection bar's Add to selection toggle. Keep it to three status lines on a 360 dp phone, about 80 characters. The pan and zoom clause comes first: a large font leaves the status one or two lines, and the part cut off is the end.

status_wire_touch.en: Two fingers pan and zoom. Tap a terminal, wire, or grid point, then the destination.
status_wire_touch.pt: Dois dedos: mover e zoom. Toque num terminal, fio ou ponto e depois no destino.
status_wire_touch.description: Wiring Tool hint on touch. Keep it to three status lines on a 360 dp phone, about 80 characters. The pan and zoom clause comes first: a large font leaves the status one or two lines, and the part cut off is the end.

touch_help_editing.en: 4. Choose a component in Library, then tap the circuit to insert it. With the Edit Tool, Select or Move, tap a component to select it: the bar at the bottom of the circuit rotates, duplicates, copies or deletes the selection, and Add selects several items. Long-press a component for its menu, and open Properties to change its label and attributes. Undo and Redo recover edits.
touch_help_editing.pt: 4. Escolha um componente na Biblioteca e toque no circuito para inseri-lo. Com a Ferramenta de edição, Selecionar ou Mover, toque num componente para selecioná-lo: a barra na parte inferior do circuito gira, duplica, copia ou apaga a seleção, e Adicionar seleciona vários itens. Toque e segure um componente para abrir o menu dele e abra Propriedades para alterar o rótulo e os atributos. Desfazer e Refazer recuperam edições.

touch_help_library.en: 1. Use File → Open example to load SAP-1 or AND. The Library button (Explorer on wide screens) shows three tabs: Circuits, with the circuits in the file; Library, with the components to insert; and Search, for circuits, components and commands.
touch_help_library.pt: 1. Use Arquivo → Abrir exemplo para carregar SAP-1 ou AND. O botão Biblioteca (Explorador em telas largas) mostra três abas: Circuitos, com os circuitos do arquivo; Biblioteca, com os componentes para inserir; e Buscar, para circuitos, componentes e comandos.

touch_help_simulation.en: 3. With the Poke Tool, tap inputs to change them. Step advances the clock; Run repeats steps until Pause. Reset restarts the simulation.
touch_help_simulation.pt: 3. Com a Ferramenta Testar, toque nas entradas para alterá-las. Passo avança o clock; Executar repete os passos até Pausar. Reiniciar devolve a simulação ao estado inicial.

touch_help_viewport.en: 2. Pinch with two fingers to zoom and drag with two fingers to pan; with the Poke Tool one finger also pans. Tap the zoom percentage for Fit, 100% and a slider that zooms as it moves; View → Fit also shows the entire circuit.
touch_help_viewport.pt: 2. Faça pinça com dois dedos para ampliar e arraste com dois dedos para deslocar; com a Ferramenta Testar, um dedo também desloca. Toque na porcentagem do zoom para Enquadrar, 100% e um controle deslizante que amplia enquanto se move; Exibir → Enquadrar também mostra o circuito inteiro.
